name: Sujan Guragain
description: DevOps, cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity. Selected work and practical engineering notes by Sujan Guragain, based in Kathmandu, Nepal.
intro: I’m Sujan, a DevOps and security engineer based in Kathmandu. I help teams ship with confidence and keep critical infrastructure running.
about: My work sits at the intersection of systems administration, delivery automation and network security. From keeping production Linux services healthy to modernizing firewalls and building private AI platforms, I care about systems that people can understand, operate and trust.

experience.description: Production Linux services, Jenkins delivery pipelines, Proxmox infrastructure, monitoring, backup and recovery, and internal AI tooling.
Check Point infrastructure modernization, high-availability validation, controlled upgrades and security operations for enterprise environments.
AWS infrastructure, release automation, monitoring, hosting operations and technical support for customer workloads.
IT support and systems troubleshooting; the foundation of my path into infrastructure engineering.
